syntaxDimensions.name: Workspace/source state
syntaxDimensions.surface: Open overlay, disk snapshot, scratch file, configured roots, multi-file modules, missing/deleted/renamed files, schema absent/stale/invalid.

syntaxDimensions.name: Top-level declarations
syntaxDimensions.surface: `pub`, `use`, `const`, contextual `state`, `extern state`, `fn`, parameters, default parameters, `struct`, fields, `enum`, variants, `trait`, default/interface methods, inherent and trait `impl`.

syntaxDimensions.name: Function and method bodies
syntaxDimensions.surface: Locals, explicit type hints, assignments, compound assignments, returns, nested blocks, `if`, `match`, loops, lambdas, closures, callbacks.

syntaxDimensions.name: Type positions
syntaxDimensions.surface: Primitive hints, builtin containers, `Option`/`Result`, source types, schema host types, traits, missing type facts, dynamic `Any` and unknown.

syntaxDimensions.name: Members and constructors
syntaxDimensions.surface: Source/schema fields, methods, trait methods, enum variants, tuple/record/unit variants, record constructors, shorthand fields, field labels, member writes.

syntaxDimensions.name: Calls and arguments
syntaxDimensions.surface: Source functions, source methods, stdlib functions/methods, schema functions/methods, named arguments, defaulted parameters, active parameter tracking, dynamic or unresolved calls.

syntaxDimensions.name: Patterns and control flow
syntaxDimensions.surface: `match` enum patterns, record-variant fields, binding patterns, guards where supported, `for` iteration, `break`, `continue`, control-flow keywords.

syntaxDimensions.name: Literals and operators
syntaxDimensions.surface: Strings, bytes, numbers, booleans, unit, tuples, arrays, maps, sets, records, unary/binary/logical operators, ranges, indexing, punctuation families.

syntaxDimensions.name: Modules and imports
syntaxDimensions.surface: Qualified module paths, imported declarations, import aliases if supported, private/public visibility, source-backed schema spans, unresolved imports.

syntaxDimensions.name: Error recovery
syntaxDimensions.surface: Parser recovery, incomplete member/call/type contexts, malformed declarations, unresolved names, diagnostics with candidates, partial stale facts.

syntaxDimensions.name: Symbol ownership
syntaxDimensions.surface: Local, parameter, source declaration, source member, source variant, schema/host fact, stdlib fact, builtin fact, module, dynamic `Any`, unresolved.

syntaxDimensions.name: Incrementality and cancellation
syntaxDimensions.surface: Repeated queries, body-only edits, declaration/import fingerprint changes, reverse dependency invalidation, request cancellation, generation rejection.

syntaxDimensions.name: Trivia and formatting
syntaxDimensions.surface: Comments, shebang trivia, blank-line groups, indentation, top-level item spans, nested member spans, malformed-source fallback.

syntaxDimensions.name: Rust-analyzer-aligned authoring UX
syntaxDimensions.surface: Compact generic-like type formatting, typed receiver dot completion, field-declaration contexts, completion label/detail separation, and statement snippets for Rust-like constructs.

syntaxDimensions.name: Rust-analyzer-style authoring core
syntaxDimensions.surface: Structured `CompletionAnalysis`, path/type/dot/declaration/call/pattern/statement contexts, expected type/name, unified member index, and editor-neutral item rendering before LSP projection.
